environment: Chrome headless, Vite development, synthetic IPC, 300 mixed cards and 200 workflow input wires
method: 48 synthetic input events in four groups of 12; flushSync wraps each dispatch, then two real animation frames allow scheduled work. React still coalesces some native-event commits. Counts describe a deterministic stress fixture, not native event cadence or FPS.
checks: mixed multi-selection drag persists final geometry
wire follows live moving content ports before pointerup
pointerup flushes an unpainted final move
Escape cancels an unpainted move without later drift
same-frame drag threshold roundtrip does not activate asset
wheel then resize in one task uses live zoom
route flush persists latest wheel view before camera settles
stationary workflow resize invalidates drag snap geometry
